The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
I was at my job, which entailed doing data entry (graveyard shift) for a courier company. I had bought and ingested as many as 20 Sudafed pills in the past (never at work) with nice results. The hyperactivity, elevated sociability and overall euphoria were all a plus for me. On this particular night (which coincided with my last day of my junior year of college) I felt a need to celebrate. So, I bought the jumbo 48 count Suphedrine brand nasal decongestant and went off to work. After working for about ten minutes, I snuck off to the bathroom with my Suphedrine and a bottle of Sunny Delight. I found the pills a tad nauseating to get down, so I stopped at 41. Out of pure anticipation of the coming high, my heart began to beat a little faster. I returned to my workstation, none of my co-workers even suspecting a thing.
12:40am- I barely realized the high had set on me. Only that I was incessantly chattering with the girl in my adjoining workstation did I realize I was 'getting there'.
1:30am- My work productivity is speeding up ever-so-much. The euphoria is beginning to wash over my body. I don't mind typing, much less at close to 2am in the morning. I am aware, however, that my co-workers probably view this as being VERY strange.
2:40am-I'm totally awash in a tingling feeling - not anything like MDMA - but nonetheless, VERY NICE! I start to sweat a little more than normal, so I take my break and walk down to the local deli. Just as a sidenote, when I used MDMA, I only wanted to be inside a space which had walls - I found being on MDMA indoors like a nice, warm security blanket. When I did go outdoors, it made me slightly paranoid and left me longing for the safety of the walls. On pseudoephedrine, going outside is like giving myself an exhilarating little treat. The air immediately cools me down and I just float along.
3:00am-I return, with a sandwich and soda, just to prove that I left for a reason other than to aid my high.
3:15am-The euphoria effect I've been having is not diminishing, but feeling a bit less exhilirating. For some unknown reason, I start to think about a girl who I had a crush on in college. My mind started playing out a scenario that breached even the Harlequin standard of ethics. I immediately became aroused, all the while typing away fervently.
3:30am- I can state this now with a good laugh, but the fact of the matter is that by half-past 3, I was ready to ejaculate in my pants. I could feel that my arousal had also caused me to become flush red in the face.
4:00am- Good news! We can all go home early because I completed twice my usual workload. I was thrilled, as I was looking at a completely different 'workload' that was building up to be three times my norm.
5:00am- The train heads back into Brooklyn. Fantastically, my initial high (coupled with the horniness) has returned. I smile and watch all of the tired people beginning their work day. When I got home, I ran to the bathroom and felt an unparalleled jolt of pleasure, via 'taking care of business.' I went and lay down on my bed and felt my heart beating fast, but not too fast. I was shocked-126bpm! I had expected much higher, but this was pretty good. Sweet ending of all endings was that I fell asleep in 25 minutes.
The verdict: Awesome! Of course I woke up the next day feeling pretty sad and deprived of some chemicals, but I wasn't stupid enough to start doing the Suphedrine right again. In fact, it wasn't for another 7 months that I even tried again. The downside is that I was never to match my work productivity of that night. Still, a great night!
